stories.h: Port of Seattle admits it got notice of SEA ICE arrest
stories.s: After saying it had no warning, the Port now says TSA gave it limited notice before ICE arrested a man on a jetway at Sea-Tac. The Port has ordered an independent investigation into how its employees handled the arrest.

stories.h: Good To Go phone line back; toll website still down
stories.s: WSDOT took MyGoodToGo.com offline Nov. 22 after a cyber intrusion attempt, and it has no return date. Customers can pay by phone at 1-866-936-8246 and ask to waive late fees from the outage. Tolls are still being recorded.

stories.h: Seattle home prices falling fastest among major US cities
stories.s: A First American analysis finds Seattle-area single-family prices fell more over the past year than in any other major U.S. city. Its economist cites uncertainty in tech jobs and buyers' sensitivity to mortgage rates.

stories.h: Environmental group sues King County over West Point discharges
stories.s: Puget Soundkeeper Alliance has filed a federal suit claiming the West Point treatment plant discharges nitrogen and phosphorus into Puget Sound without valid permit coverage. It asks a court to stop the discharges and impose daily penalties.

coming.s: Tree lighting at Depot Park from 5 to 8 p.m. with free Santa photos, a children's winter market and live music.

coming.h: Kent Winterfest parade and tree lighting
coming.s: Performances at Town Square Plaza start at 2:30 p.m., the parade steps off on Ramsay Way at 5 p.m., and the tree is lit at 6 p.m.

coming.h: Auburn Santa Parade and tree lighting
coming.s: Music at Auburn City Hall starts at 4 p.m., with the parade about 30 minutes later and the tree lighting after.

coming.h: Snoqualmie tree lighting and holiday market
coming.s: Holiday market on Railroad Ave. from 3 to 6 p.m. with jazz and Santa photos; the tree is lit at 5:30 p.m.
